description: NaBi₂Sb₃O₁₁ crystallizes in the cubic Pn̅3 space group. Na is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are two shorter (2.46 Å) and six longer (2.59 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Bi is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Bi-O bond lengths are 2.23 Å. Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 52°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.04 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and three equivalent Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaBi₃ tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to two equivalent Sb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Sb atoms.
